fields.description: Issue features extensive coverage of the upcoming Miami city commission election (primary announced for Nov. 15), including a Miami Life election poll and candidate statements. Major political reporting attacks candidate Leonard K. Thomson’s record, focusing on utility and garbage taxes, homestead exemption repeal advocacy, and the proposed consolidation of city and county tax assessor functions and its impact on residential vs. downtown commercial property assessments. The issue also reports on a Congressional investigation involving Cuban figure Jose Aleman and the transfer/exile of Miami immigration officials, including discussion of Harold McIntyre and W. F. Miller. Additional local items include a petition against Southern Bell Telephone and Telegraph Company pay-phone practices, commentary on Miami transit/bus changes and downtown traffic, and crime/courts coverage including incidents at the Orange Bowl and municipal court cases.
